data: Apple's diluted earnings per share were $6.08 in fiscal 2024 (year ended September 28, 2024) versus $6.13 in fiscal 2023 (year ended September 30, 2023), a decline of $0.05, or about 0.8%. Net income for fiscal 2024 was $93,736 million (about $93.7 billion), down from $96,995 million in fiscal 2023, a decrease of roughly 3.4%. EPS fell by less than net income because the diluted share count dropped from about 15.81 billion to 15.41 billion shares as a result of buybacks.
